title: The Lancashire Creamery Ice Raspberry Ripple 100ml Shortfill
description: Raspberry Ripple from The Lancashire Creamery blends a creamy Vanilla ice cream base with a swirl of sweet, ripe Raspberry sauce. The result is a smooth, indulgent dessert vape with a fruity brightness. With a 70% VG / 30% PG ratio, this high-VG shortfill is designed for Direct-to-Lung (DTL) vaping with sub-ohm kits, producing thick clouds and delivering consistently rich flavour. Supplied in a 120ml bottle containing 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s space for two 10ml nicotine shots to create a 3mg mix. The Lancashire Creamery is a UK-based e-liquid brand celebrated for indulgent dessert blends inspired by traditional ice cream parlour favourites. Their shortfills are crafted to deliver smooth, creamy profiles ideal for sweet, decadent vaping.
